visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt featuring a graphic design and blue jeans, sits comfortably on the floor next to a large silver 'CRAZY LAZY' tote bag. She looks directly at the camera with a neutral expression in a room with plain, beige-toned walls and soft ambient lighting. (2) The scene transitions to a medium close-up of the woman, now wearing a green and black horizontal striped long-sleeved shirt. She is holding a pair of sunglasses and adjusting her hair, standing against a simple, light-colored background that emphasizes her casual and modern appearance. (3) A brief outdoor scene features the woman crouching in a garden area, holding a small baby dressed in a grey beanie and dark sunglasses. The background consists of a red brick wall, green leafy plants, and a citrus tree, suggesting a sunny and pleasant day. (4) Back in an indoor domestic setting, the woman is seated on the floor wearing a thick grey knitted sweater. She addresses the camera directly, using animated hand gestures to explain her hair styling routine, with a wooden dresser and a lamp visible in the soft-focus background. (5) The woman holds up a small blue circular container of 'Nigelle Texture Clay' and a tall, slender grey spray can to the camera, presenting them as her primary tools. She examines the products briefly before refocusing her attention on the audience to continue her explanation. (6) Opening the blue clay container, she uses her fingertips to scoop out a small portion of the product. She then rubs her palms together in a circular motion, ensuring the clay is thoroughly warmed and evenly distributed across her hands and fingers before application. (7) She begins to work the clay into her hair, using her fingers like a comb to lift the roots and create texture. She focuses on the crown and sides, tilting her head and looking into the camera lens as if it were a mirror to monitor her progress. (8) Picking up the hairspray can, she applies several short, targeted bursts to her styled hair. Simultaneously, she uses her free hand to scrunch and position individual strands, ensuring the 'wolf cut' maintains its volume and desired messy-yet-controlled aesthetic. (9) The tutorial concludes with the woman adjusting a few wisps of hair over her forehead to perfect the look. She presents the final, textured hairstyle to the camera with a satisfied and confident expression, demonstrating the completed result of her styling efforts.
